remote.intro: Expose the agent running on this computer to another device over the web — a phone, a tablet, or a browser on another computer.
remote.setupDesc: Set a password. Other devices log in with it to connect. The password is kept only on this computer.
remote.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match
remote.enableDesc: When on, other devices can log in with the password and connect to the agent on this computer.
remote.clientsDesc: Devices currently logged in and connected.
remote.noDevices: No device has logged in yet.
remote.changePasswordDesc: Changing the password signs every device out.
remote.changePasswordWarning: Setting a new password signs every logged-in device out; they will need it to log back in.
remote.turnOffDesc: Stops the server and clears the password. Every logged-in device is signed out.
